label: Terrain invented for this edition, shaped to fit the book. (Draft label.) AI-made: generated by code written by an AI model, Claude (the coding agent, a closed model); every book-fixed feature is pinned and every placement keeps its "book" or "placed by us" mark. Not by the author.
license: Generated for Snowmoon by Vitalik Buterin on 2026-10-11. GPL-3.0, like the book.

assist.drafted: the generator code and its parameters; no model generates terrain or images

method: Layered gradient noise with ridged mountain noise (scripts/lib/noise.ts); soft pulls toward the book's land and sea; hard pins; stream-power and slope-collapse erosion with the pins re-applied each pass; the book's river carved downhill; priority-flood depression filling so every land cell drains to the sea or the map edge; D8 flow and accumulation; rivers above a drainage area; climate from latitude (-25 + 52·cos(latitude) °C, minus 6.5 °C per km of height) and rain carried by the prevailing winds and lost over high ground (rain shadow).
